method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind comment where it does not answer); a dates module with built-in date functions only (lid-dates.l4: the Act's plain 120 days, the Supreme Court Rules' rr 3.01, 3.04, 3.05(2), 3.08), a seat-neutral core with every operative section and narrow restatements of Wrongs Act s 88(ba), s 93, Limitation of Actions Act ss 27O-27Q and Rules Order 85 (lid-core.l4), and one seat layer that restates no rule (lid-seat.l4, 18 questions with @export and @desc); one regulative rule (s 7(3) and Order 85: nomination, service, amended process, or the plaintiff's s 8 application), tested by EVALTRACE, never taken as an input; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seat: the survivor: a person who was abused as a child and is looking for an organisational defendant to sue, where the organisation is an unincorporated non-government organisation that uses a trust (the plaintiff)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run lid-dates.l4 ; l4 run lid-core.l4 ; l4 run lid-seat.l4 ; l4 run lid-cases.l4
checks.result: 90 written, 90 satisfied in lid-cases.l4; 0 errors, 0 warnings in all four files (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read; a copy of the case file with two expected values changed was run first to confirm failures are reported, and not kept.

scope: In: ss 3-13 (every operative section); read with Wrongs Act 1958 s 88(ba), s 93; Limitation of Actions Act 1958 ss 27O(1), 27P(1), 27Q(1); Supreme Court (General Civil Procedure) Rules 2025 rr 3.01, 3.04, 3.05(2), 3.08, 85.02-85.04. Inputs: the court's judgments and orders (s 4(2)(b), s 7(3), s 8(1)(b), s 8(4), s 10, r 85.03), the trust's powers, the value of the trust property. Out: ss 1, 2, 14, 15 and the repealed ss 16-20 (machinery); within the Act, s 5(2), (3), ss 7(4), 8(8), 8(6), (7) and s 12(2) as notes; the rest of Wrongs Act Part XIII and Part XIIIA (in the Wrongs Act's own encoding), Limitation Act ss 27F, 27OA, 27QA-27T, public holidays for the Rules' counting. See NOTES.md.
